1.text: Tha elder 2 tha wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in tha truth.
Beloved, I wish above all things dat u may prosper N be in health, even as ur soul prospereth.
4 I rejoiced greatly, when tha brothers came N testified of tha truth dat is in u, even as u walk in tha truth.
I have no greater joy than 2 hear dat my children walk in truth.
Beloved, u do faithfully whatever u do 2 tha brothers, N 2 strangers;
Which have borne witness of ur charity before tha church: whom if u bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, u will do well:
Because dat 4 his name’s sake dey went forth, takin nothing of tha Gentiles.
We therefore ought 2 receive such, dat we might be fellowhelpers 2 tha truth.
I wrote 2 tha church: but Diotrephes, who loves 2 have tha preeminence among ’em, receives us not.

So, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, prating against us wit malicious words: N not content wit it, neither does he himself receive tha brothers, N forbiddeth ’em dat would, N casts ’em out of tha church.
Beloved, follow not dat which is evil, but dat which is good. He dat does good is of God: but he dat does evil has not seen God.
Demetrius has good report of all men, N of tha truth itself: yeah, N we also bear record; N y’all know dat our record is true.
I had many things 2 write, but I will not wit ink N pen write 2 u:
But I trust I shall shortly see u, N we shall speak face 2 face. Peace be 2 u. Our friends greet u. Greet tha friends by name.
